newsitem.title: INDIA: U.S. FCC chief seeks easy telecom licencing rules.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FCC chief seeks easy telecom licencing rules.

text.p: Governments around the world must free telecommunications licensing and create conditions for a worldwide network to fuel growth, the chairman of the U.S. Federal Communications Commission said on Thursday.
Reed Hundt told a seminar on telecommunications in the Indian capital that communications costs were dipping to help high economic growth, which could go up further as communication costs come down.
The transmission of sound and images on telecommunication lines were adding to the demand, calling for a major shift in telecommunications, he said.
"At least have as many licences as can be possibly created," Hundt said, adding that licences should be limited only in the use of wireless technology because of physical limitations.
"Let me say, right now in global terms in every country, the existing communications network tends to stifle growth," Hundt said. "Worldwide, the system of monopolies is an obstacle to growth."
